anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of De Oratione exists (only copyrighted Greer/O'Meara/Oulton-Chadwick); nothing to compare against. Sense checked against the Greek and cited Scripture wording.

apparatus: Jn 14:23 co-reigning; kingdom of God (hegemonikon state) vs of Christ (words/works).

choices.why: eunomoumenēn = under good law; the saint dwells in himself as a city under God's spiritual laws.
theopoieō = make divine; the praying disposition is god-made by the Word — theosis in prayer.

pass_a_gloss: Kingdom comes unobserved because within: pray its rise/fruit/perfection in self-as-city under Father and co-reigning Christ. God's kingdom = blessed hegemonikon-state; Christ's = saving words and righteous works. The always-pray objection dissolves via partial-knowledge: pray ever for more, journeying to the summit when Christ delivers the kingdom that God be all in all. Incompatibility with sin's kingdom; mortify, bear Spirit-fruit, walk paradise, seat Christ at the right hand within until death the last enemy falls and corruptible wears incorruption.
